title: You offered to host
idea: The group chat turns the host into a help desk. One event link makes room for the actual party.
music: An original instrumental for a witty stylish social video. Exactly 24 seconds, 120 BPM, playful dry plucked bass, crisp claps, bouncy house drums and warm chopped keyboard chords. First 4 seconds: stripped back mischievous pluck and ticking percussion, then a very brief stop at 4 seconds. At 4.5 seconds the full infectious funky house groove drops, energetic but relaxed, like a great summer dinner party. New small rhythmic details every 2 seconds. Clean strong ending at 24 seconds. Contemporary, human groove, premium mix, no corporate stock music, no ukulele, no vocals, no voices, no artist imitation.

shots.chaos: Create a 10 second vertical 9:16 live action comedy reaction shot for a TikTok. Entirely fictional adults. Candid handheld smartphone footage, real skin texture, ordinary cozy apartment with warm late afternoon window light, not glossy advertising. A 28 year old woman with chin-length dark brown curly hair, warm medium skin, wearing an oversized cobalt blue button-up over a white tee and jeans is preparing a small dinner party at her kitchen island. Flowers, a salad bowl, mismatched plates. Keep her face centered around the upper-middle of the frame. [0-2 seconds] She holds a black smartphone low at chest level, pleased with her party prep. The phone buzzes and she looks down. [2-4 seconds] It buzzes again. She looks straight at the camera with a tiny deadpan eyebrow raise: you can feel her regret at offering to host. [4-7 seconds] More short notification buzzes. She glances down, then stares incredulously into the camera and exhales a small frustrated laugh. [7-10 seconds] She places the phone face down and gives the camera a knowing half smile. Subtle push in, one continuous shot. Natural quiet kitchen ambience and a few short generic notification pings only, no music, no spoken words, no lip moving as if speaking, no subtitles, no text overlays, no logos. Phone screen is never legible. Understated genuinely believable comedic acting, not exaggerated facial expressions.
shots.party: Create a new 10 second vertical 9:16 video using the same fictional woman, her curly dark bob and cobalt blue shirt, and the same apartment as the previous video. This is later that evening. Candid handheld smartphone footage, natural human details, warm practical lamps, energetic but intimate house party with six adult friends. [0-3 seconds] Medium shot: the host opens the door smiling; a friend enters and hugs her naturally, one arm around shoulder, other guests behind. [3-5 seconds] Hard cut to closeup of hands setting down a bowl of chips on a colorful crowded table. [5-8 seconds] Hard cut to the host at the table laughing at a friend's joke, the whole gathering relaxed and animated. [8-10 seconds] Closeup: she raises her glass of sparkling water to the camera, playful half smile, friends blurred behind her. Natural warm room light, direct flash feeling on the final toast, slight handheld movement, no slow motion, no glossy stock-photo posing. Distinct readable actions, consistent people and clothing. Sound: quiet real party chatter and laughter, clink of glasses. No understandable dialogue, no music, no subtitles, no text, no logos. Phone absent. Faces and hands anatomically natural. The scene feels like the best night your friend documented on their phone.
